practice.prompt: A circle has radius 6 and central angle 90°. Find the coefficient of π in the sector area.
A sector has radius 4 and central angle 180°. Find the coefficient of π in its area.
practice.solution: A semicircle is half the disk: (180/360)π(4²)=8π.

practice.prompt: A 360° sector has radius 3. Find the coefficient of π in its area.
practice.solution: A full turn is the entire circle, so area=π(3²)=9π.

practice.prompt: A sector has radius 10 and central angle 36°. Find the coefficient of π in its area.
practice.solution: The fraction is 36/360=1/10. Multiply by r²=100 to get area 10π.

practice.prompt: A radius-12 sector has a central angle of 30°. Find the coefficient of π in its area.
practice.solution: Thirty degrees is one twelfth of a full turn. Area=(1/12)π(144)=12π.

practice.prompt: A sector has radius 9 and angle 120°. Find the coefficient of π in its area.
A sector has radius 8 and angle 45°. Find the coefficient of π in its area.
A circular garden sector has radius 15 m and central angle 72°. Find the coefficient of π in its area in m².
A sector has radius 6 and angle 60°. Find the coefficient of π in its area.
A sector in a circle of radius 10 has area 25π. Find its central angle in degrees.
A semicircular sector has area 18π. Find its radius.
A sector has radius 14 and angle 90°. Find the coefficient of π in its area.
practice.solution: The sector is a quarter circle: (1/4)π(14²)=49π.

practice.prompt: A sector has radius 18 and central angle 40°. Find the coefficient of π in its area.
A sector has radius 12 and central angle 90°. Find the coefficient of π in its ARC LENGTH (not area).
practice.solution: Arc length=(90/360)×2π×12=(1/4)×24π=6π. Do not use the area formula.

practice.prompt: An annular sector has outer radius 10, inner radius 6, and angle 90°. Find the coefficient of π in its area.
A sector has radius 20 and angle 27°. Find the coefficient of π in its area.
Two adjacent sectors of the same radius-12 circle have central angles 75° and 45°. Find the coefficient of π in their COMBINED area.
practice.solution: Combine angles first: 75°+45°=120°. The area is (120/360)π(12²)=48π.

practice.prompt: An annular sector has outer radius 10, inner radius 2, and area 24π. Find its central angle in degrees.
